_comment: Single source of truth for the reference camera settings. Used by the camera-recovery procedure and by camera_server.py's /api/health. Exposure depends on the sample: a clear supernatant sample uses 20 (from 2026-07-13) / a uniformly turbid sample uses 156 (older baseline). 'reference' is for macOS (uvc-util names; the key names must not change because the recovery script reads them directly). 'win32' is for Windows (hw.py logical names: auto_exposure/exposure/gain/auto_focus/focus/auto_wb/wb_temp). Left null until calibrated on real Windows hardware (in that case camera_server.py treats matches_reference as None = cannot determine).
